content.subject: Embedding finance in logistics
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that ShipMonk highlighted modern CFOs embedding themselves directly in warehouse and logistics operations. I imagine keeping data aligned across warehouse and finance systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract data from warehouse systems and feed it into finance tools, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
